page: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-8 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical Intel Xeon cores running at 2.8 GHz, with hyper-threading enabled. The processor includes a 33 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

Benchmark results indicate average performance across most standard operations. The instance achieves middle-tier results in multi-core CPU stress tests, memory bandwidth, and static web serving throughput. However, it exhibits weaker performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core metrics, and physics simulations. Cryptographic operations and database tasks, such as Redis SET operations, perform within the average range.

Given its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the n2-standard-8 offers a predictable resource profile for standard enterprise workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for general-purpose applications that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. Recommended workloads include static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and general-purpose application hosting.
